summary: Implemented Lambda (monai/transforms/utility/array.py, appended at end) and Lambdad with LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases (monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py). Lambdad subclasses MapTransform, wraps one internal Lambda, and applies it per key to a dict shallow copy. Added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst (Lambda before SplitChannel, Lambdad after ConcatItemsd) and tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py (identity, spatial slicing, plus a keys-view test in the Lambdad file). The only removed line in the diff is the typing import, which became "from typing import Callable, Optional". Nothing was committed. Tests, flake8 and black were not run, per instructions; line lengths and trailing whitespace were checked by reading and awk.
